c4isr_products.name: Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) integrated data layer prototype for 25th Infantry Division
c4isr_products.description: Army-prototyped division-level C2 stack built on a common data layer to give a continuous operating picture across echelons; Lockheed Martin is team lead for the 25th ID prototype with partners including Raft and Accelint. FACT (army.mil, lockheedmartin.com, Sept 2025 - Feb 2026).
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Inputs: sensor feeds, unit position/status data, fires and ISR data from division/brigade systems. Process: ingest/normalize into common data layer, apps for planning, fires, sustainment. Output: shared operating picture and fires execution workflows. Users: 25th ID commanders and staff (division to battalion).

c4isr_products.name: Command and Control, Battle Management and Communications (C2BMC) / C2BMC-Next
c4isr_products.description: Integrating element of the U.S. Missile Defense System that links sensors, shooters and command centers globally; C2BMC-Next upgrade awarded April 2024 by MDA and stated to support JADC2 integration. FACT (MDA award via lockheedmartin.com, Defense News, Breaking Defense, Apr 2024).
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Inputs: radar/space sensor tracks (e.g., AN/TPY-2, SBIRS/OPIR, Aegis). Process: track fusion, engagement planning, sensor tasking. Output: integrated missile-defense picture and engagement recommendations to combatant commands. Users: MDA, USNORTHCOM/USSTRATCOM, combatant command missile-defense cells.

c4isr_products.name: Aegis Combat System / Aegis Ashore
c4isr_products.description: Ship- and shore-based integrated air and missile defense combat management system for U.S. Navy and allied navies. RECALL - not re-verified this session, confidence HIGH on existence.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Inputs: SPY radar and off-board tracks. Process: track management, threat evaluation, weapon assignment. Output: engagement orders to interceptors, tactical picture. Users: Navy ship crews, Aegis Ashore sites, allied navies (Japan, Spain, Australia, ROK, Norway).

c4isr_products.name: Skunk Works JADC2 experimentation (Project Hydra, Keystone/5G.MIL, DEIMOS)
c4isr_products.description: Company-funded and government demo efforts to link F-35/F-22/U-2 and ground nodes and to provide open, containerized C2 middleware. RECALL - not re-verified this session, confidence MEDIUM; demo-level, not programs of record.

companies.exact_problem_solved: Integrating disparate sensors, shooters and C2 nodes into a single decision picture: at the strategic level for missile defense (C2BMC) and, since 2025, at the division/tactical level via a common data layer (NGC2 25th ID).
primary_users: Missile Defense Agency and combatant commands (C2BMC)
primary_buyers: U.S. Army (NGC2 program office / PEO C3N and Army Futures Command)
companies.hw_sw_mix: both - NGC2 work is software/data-layer integration; C2BMC and Aegis are large software systems tied to Lockheed-built sensors and interceptors.

companies.evidence_repeat_procurement: C2BMC: successive spiral contracts culminating in $4.1B ceiling IDIQ (2024) with ~$847M in initial task orders (HIGH). NGC2: single $26M OTA; follow-on not verified (LOW).
companies.evidence_prototype_to_production: C2BMC and Aegis are mature production programs. NGC2 remains a prototype; the Army's stated 2026 plan is to expand to corps and additional divisions, but a Lockheed production transition is not verified. Public evidence insufficient.
companies.tech_stack_inference_from_jobs: INFERENCE (no job-posting search performed this session): NGC2 data-layer work implies Kubernetes/containerized microservices, DevSecOps pipelines and data-mesh style APIs consistent with Army NGC2 characteristics of need; C2BMC uses large legacy real-time software with periodic spiral upgrades. companies.confidence_notes: NGC2 award value ($26M OTA, Sept 2025) and exercise events verified via army.mil, Breaking Defense and company releases. C2BMC figures verified via April 2024 releases. Aegis/Skunk Works items are RECALL. No usaspending obligation data pulled this session.
